experiment_data.hypothesis: Depth signal persists at 14B scale without quantization: Qwen2.5-14B FP16 achieves 4-class acc >= 65% with top features including p90_ppl/var_surprisal, confirming recursive degradation is model-scale-invariant
experiment_data.notes: plan_014: 14B FP16 scale validation. 5000 samples/depth, d0-d3, self-reference features (Qwen2.5-14B computes surprisal on its own generations). LoRA r=16 alpha=32 q/k/v_proj, 3 epochs, lr=2e-4. No quantization (unlike Qwen7B QLoRA experiment). Gradient checkpointing for VRAM management.
